definition_zh: 电池；炮兵连；一组；殴打（法律）
definition_en: a device storing electric energy; an artillery unit; a set or series; unlawful beating
core_image: 手电筒里首尾相接的两节小圆柱
scene: 停电的夜里，收音机突然没了声音。The radio died because the battery was flat.
sceneCN: 这里 battery 指「电池」（第 1 个义项：储电装置）；句意：收音机不响了，因为电池没电了。

derivatives.zh: 电池供电的（复合形容词）

senses.title: The electric cell
senses.definition: a container that stores chemical energy as electricity
senses.example: Insert two AA batteries before use.
senses.exampleCN: 使用前装入两节五号电池。
senses.why: Benjamin Franklin linked toy Leyden jars in a battery, a row of guns.
senses.whyCN: 富兰克林把串联的莱顿瓶比作一列炮，称 battery。

senses.title: An artillery unit
senses.definition: a tactical unit of guns and their crews
senses.definitionCN: 火炮与炮手编成的战术单位
senses.example: An artillery battery opened fire at dawn.
senses.why: French batterie meant the action of battering; guns batter.
senses.whyCN: 法语 batterie 意为「猛击」；炮即猛击之器。

senses.title: A set or series
senses.definition: a group of similar things used together
senses.definitionCN: 一起使用的一组相似事物
senses.example: She faced a battery of interviews.
senses.why: Guns in a row became anything in a row.
senses.whyCN: 成列的炮化为成列的任何物。

senses.title: The crime of beating
senses.definition: unlawful physical contact or violence against a person
senses.definitionCN: 对他人身体的非法侵犯或暴力
senses.example: He was charged with assault and battery.
senses.why: Law took the beating word straight from batter.
senses.whyCN: 法律径取 batter「击打」之义。

senses.title: Battery of kitchen tools
senses.definition: a set of matched pots and pans
senses.why: Same row-idea, domesticated for the kitchen.

senses.title: Rechargeable batteries
senses.definition: batteries that can be restored by charging
senses.definitionCN: 可通过充电恢复的电池
senses.exampleCN: 锂电池为大多数手机供电。
senses.why: Chemistry learned to run the storm in reverse.
senses.whyCN: 化学学会了让反应倒着走。

senses.title: Battery chicken farming
senses.why: Hens stacked in rows like cells in a battery.
senses.whyCN: 母鸡如电池般成排成格。

senses.title: In psychiatry and testing
senses.definition: a battery of psychological or medical tests
senses.definitionCN: 成套的心理或医学测验
senses.example: The clinic ran a battery of memory tests.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所做了一系列记忆测验。
senses.why: Tests, like guns, are deployed in batteries.

intro.en: Battery comes from French batterie, from Old French battre, to beat, from Latin batuere; guns, electric cells, and test series all inherit the beating or the row.
intro.cn: battery 出自法语 batterie，源于古法语 battre「击打」，上溯拉丁 batuere；火炮、电池与成套测验皆承其「击打」或「成列」之义。

items.en: batuere meant to beat, to strike.
items.cn: 拉丁语 batuere 意为击打。

items.en: battre kept the beating sense; batterie meant assault.
items.cn: 古法语 battre 保留击打义；batterie 指攻击。

items.en: The word named artillery in action.
English took battery for bombardment, then for the gun unit.
items.cn: 英语先取「炮击」义，再指炮兵单位。

items.en: Franklin's battery of jars started the electric sense.
items.cn: 1748 年前后富兰克林以 battery 称并联电容器，电义始焉。

items.en: The cell meaning now leads everyday speech.
items.cn: 如今电池义主导日常用语。

note.en: Group one holds the beating family and look-alikes; group two holds the energy field.
note.cn: 第一组收「击打」词族与形近词；第二组收「能量」义场。

entries.definition: to beat repeatedly; also the pancake mix and the hitter.
entries.definitionCN: 连续击打；亦指面糊与击球手。

entries.definition: combat; from the same bat- root via Latin and French.
entries.definitionCN: 战斗；同出 bat- 词根。
疯狂的；古怪的——只是与 battery 拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a single electric unit; a battery may hold many cells.
entries.definitionCN: 单个电芯；电池可含多个电芯。

entries.definition: a machine that makes electricity as it runs.
to fill a battery with energy.

normalIntro.en: battery beats twice: guns beat walls, and a row of jars became a battery of power.
normalIntro.cn: battery 击打两次：炮击城墙，成列的瓶子又成了电源。

abstract.en: Hear a drum line striking as one.
Battery is violence organized into usefulness.
abstract.cn: battery 是被组织成有用的暴力。

abstract.en: Pocket a small thunderstorm for later.
abstract.cn: 把一场小雷暴揣进兜里备用。

examples.en: Solar panels charge the batteries by day.
examples.cn: 太阳能板白天为电池充电。

examples.en: The battery commander ordered a smoke screen.
examples.cn: 炮兵连长下令施放烟幕。

examples.en: Nurses ran a battery of blood tests.
examples.cn: 护士做了一系列血液检测。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「白特雷」——白送的小玩意特能蓄雷（电）

root: 出自法语 batterie「炮组、击打」，源于古法语 battre「击打」，上溯拉丁语 batuere；富兰克林借「成列之炮」称并联电容器，遂生电池义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fire one row: the cell, the guns, the series, the crime, the kitchen set, rechargeables, the hen cages, and the test battery.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项齐发一列：电池、火炮、系列、罪行、厨具、充电电池、鸡笼与成套测验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: guns in a row, striking as one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一列火炮，齐声轰击。

branches.en: The beating word becomes the guns.
Franklin's row of jars stores the storm.
branches.cn: 富兰克林的一列瓶子把雷暴存起来。

branches.en: Tests and tools borrow the row.
Pans and hens stand in ranks too.
branches.cn: 锅具与母鸡亦列队而立。

intro.en: The bat- beating root runs through war, kitchen, and law.
intro.cn: bat-「击打」词根贯穿战争、厨房与法律。

latinIntro.en: Latin batuere and its French battre feed the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 batuere 与法语 battre 哺育整个词族。
